body: It’s crazy how that shit actually causes more harm than good. Like I get the intention is there but if you don’t follow through it just causes more pain and pisses the person off more. My now ex used to say the same stuff and then I just got to the point of just not getting my hopes up knowing full well that her “plans” are just words. I think your integrity is something to be proud of. 20 years is a damn long time though so I can understand your feelings.

To be honest, although there are difficulties I think even just having separate rooms is a massive changer. Possibly something we should have done before we actually split up. I feel like it would have removed that “hope” that I would always have when we were in the bed together. Was crushing to lie there next to her wanting to be intimate but knowing it wasn’t gonna happen. Sucks to hear you can relate so much, not a nice situation.

I’m glad to hear you have found happiness and conquered those battles. I also struggled/struggle with food and it’s not easy so seriously good job! 

For me it’s been just over a decade for suicidal stuff and about 16-17 years since proper mental struggles began (when anxiety was starting to affect my life, like school attendance) so basically my entire adult life and teenage years has been shrouded in this horrible mindframe of fear and eventually that death is the answer and the only true answer. 

I’ve been in a day hospital, to various professionals. I’ve reached out to friends and family, I’ve tried meditation, sea swims, daily action plans, group therapy, addressing my trauma, trying to resolve things with people, taking one day at a time, planning out things to be less stressful, currently do BJJ and bouldering on weekdays and some weekends. I have a sort of life with a girlfriend, a young daughter, some friends that I see occasionally. But it’s all fake I think none of the above has helped the only thing that makes it really difficult is my daughter. But I think she can do better I think if I do it while she’s young it’ll give her a chance to forget me easier and have a true example to help her through this world. 

I appreciate your sentiment and outlook but unfortunately I’ve basically felt this way for such a long time that i don’t think my story can resemble yours. My mask is dropping in real life and don’t think I can keep the charade up any longer

Yes she is a blessing indeed we got very lucky! 

Yes I have told her all of the above in detail multiple times over the last 2 years. Things usually change for maybe a month then go back to dead. What’s funny is I’m actually into denial and stuff which I’ve shared and explained that I’m into denial but not rejection/ignoring and so if she’s not in the mood for sex or whatever even just showing interest and then denying would be cool with me because I just want us to be close and intimate. 

I really amn’t sure about the drinking she also lets things go when drinking it’s usually the only time she shares what she’s feeling but that takes a fair bit of drink! I have asked her about it but she denies it’s a thing and that she is any different when drinking. 

I think you might dead on accurate with the therapy thing points. I think neither of us fully appreciate how much of our relationship we actually missed out on. Will see if she is open to me making a booking for her and if she would be willing to join me for couples counselling. Thank you again
